cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(ICAXDescartesLight LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GenerateExportHeader)
find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)
set(source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/descartes_light-49e2ee3305b5d7ba5018f28cf706e0dc71ecf6cf/descartes_light/core")
set(console "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/console_bridge-1.0.2")
add_library(icax_console_bridge STATIC "${console}/src/console.cpp")
generate_export_header(icax_console_bridge BASE_NAME console_bridge EXPORT_MACRO_NAME CONSOLE_BRIDGE_DLLAPI EXPORT_FILE_NAME "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/console_bridge/console_bridge_export.h")
target_include_directories(icax_console_bridge PUBLIC "${console}/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/console_bridge")
target_compile_definitions(icax_console_bridge PUBLIC CONSOLE_BRIDGE_STATIC_DEFINE)
file(GLOB_RECURSE sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${source}/src/*.cpp")
add_library(icax_descartes_light STATIC ${sources})
target_include_directories(icax_descartes_light PUBLIC "${source}/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../coal/eigen-3.4.0")
target_link_libraries(icax_descartes_light PUBLIC icax_console_bridge OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)
foreach(target icax_descartes_light icax_console_bridge)
  target_compile_features(${target} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_definitions(${target} PUBLIC NOMINMAX _ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /O2 /Ob2 /MP4 /bigobj /utf-8 /wd4996 /wd4244 /wd4267)
  endif()
endforeach()
install(TARGETS icax_descartes_light icax_console_bridge ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/console_bridge/console_bridge_export.h" DESTINATION include/console_bridge)
